reuse.why: Threads the flag into the existing single selection rule shouldFillCategory and the getCategoriesForAverage wrapper used by every month-wide action.

duplication.why: The hidden rule changes once in shouldFillCategory; only the `includeHiddenCategories?: boolean` argument type is repeated inline on six actions instead of a shared args type.

placement.why: The rule change lands in the documented 'single definition' shouldFillCategory in budget/actions.ts.

scope.why: Only the selection rule and the month-wide action signatures change.

maintainability.why: Simple option on the shared predicate; the header comment of shouldFillCategory was not updated to mention the new option and no tests were added.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action still decides via shouldFillCategory.
